data.one_liner: Manage git hooks easily for your Dart and Flutter projects.
data.what_it_does: Husky makes it easy to manage git hooks for Dart and Flutter projects, allowing you to run tests, lint code, or check commit messages upon commit or push. It uses the modern Git feature core.hooksPath and supports macOS, Linux, and Windows.
use_when: You want to enforce code linting or formatting before commits
You want to automatically run tests before pushing code
avoid_when: Your project does not use Git
You prefer manual hook management inside .git/hooks
strengths: Easy installation and setup via Dart commands
Cross-platform support for macOS, Linux, and Windows
weaknesses: Relies on shell scripts which require Git and a proper environment on Windows
data.setup_notes: Add husky to dev_dependencies and run `dart run husky install`.
data.minimal_example:
dart pub add --dev husky
dart run husky install
dart run husky add .husky/pre-commit "dart test"
